title: A shared total
hints: total += sum is a read, an add and a write. Two goroutines can read the same old total, and then one of the updates is lost. The race detector reports exactly this.
Don't share the total. Give each goroutine its own slot to write, as in goroutines_02, and add the slots up after Wait.
partial := make([]int, len(chunks)); in goroutine i: partial[i] = sum of chunk; after wg.Wait(): total := 0; for _, p := range partial { total += p }
